articleTitle: Meta’s Muse Now Shows Its Entire Filesystem to Users

sources.title: Meta makes the Muse filesystem even more accessible
Meta’s AI Muse Exposes Filesystem with Minimal Prompting, Raising Security Concerns

claims.claim: Meta’s Muse, an AI platform that runs inside a persistent Linux virtual machine, now offers a clickable file browser when prompted.
claims.bestSource: Meta makes the Muse filesystem even more accessible
claims.evidence: Daniel Roberts, a spokesperson for Meta, asserted that Muse operates within persistent Linux virtual machines designed for individual users, emphasizing that exporting virtual machine data does not grant access to Meta’s underlying infrastructure or the data of other users.
claims.bestPassage: Daniel Roberts, a spokesperson for Meta, asserted that Muse operates within persistent Linux virtual machines designed for individual users, emphasizing that exporting virtual machine data does not grant access to Meta’s underlying infrastructure or the data of other users.

claims.claim: Users can view root, install software, compile code, and browse the web, turning the assistant into an operable Linux box.
claims.bestSource: Meta makes the Muse filesystem even more accessible
claims.evidence: You can install software in it, write and compile code, use the browser to surf the web: it is your own Linux box that you can operate as you choose with your Muse.
claims.bestPassage: You can install software in it, write and compile code, use the browser to surf the web: it is your own Linux box that you can operate as you choose with your Muse.

claims.claim: This ability to expose the entire filesystem was discovered after a user prompted the system; the response was a direct link to the root directory.
claims.bestSource: Meta’s AI Muse Exposes Filesystem with Minimal Prompting, Raising Security Concerns
claims.evidence: Yesterday, with a little prodding, it was discovered that Meta’s Muse would expose its filesystem to curious users. Both developers independently revealed that with minimal prompting, Muse was able to zip and provide access to its complete root filesystem, including Ubuntu system files, application templates, and internal documentation.

claims.claim: Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts said the company is updating the product and that users may see changes in how much information is available about their virtual machine.
